steps.subject: sky
steps.action: criss-cross sky strokes
steps.load: blue with a little van dyke brown
steps.rule: van dyke brown dulls the blue so it is less bright

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: build small fluffy clouds
steps.motion: tiny circles, let them fall off
steps.rule: keep moving or the clouds become one heavy cotton ball

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend cloud bottoms very gently
steps.motion: gentle blend, do not touch the tops
steps.rule: overworking clouds is a common mistake

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: fluff the cloud tops

steps.subject: far trees

steps.load: blue, crimson and white thinned with paint thinner
steps.rule: a thicker layer must lie under thin paint

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap the base of distant trees for mist
steps.rule: softened bottoms create the illusion of mist

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: add a closer layer with brown and umber

steps.subject: mist

steps.subject: bush
